# BasicTable

A type-safe data table with built-in column sorting, pagination, loading skeletons, and empty/error states. Column definitions use a typed `headers` array so TypeScript enforces that `key` matches a field on the row data.

```ts
import { BasicTable, SortDirection } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Basic Usage

A minimal table requires `headers`, `data`, `currentPage`, `totalPages`, and `onPageClick`. The `render` function on each column is optional — when omitted the cell displays the raw field value. The Actions column below uses `render` to compose two compact `Button` controls wrapping a tiny `Icon`, each with a `tooltip` for discoverability — Edit opens a `SidePanel` and Delete opens a `ConfirmModal`.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import {
  BasicTable,
  Button,
  ConfirmModal,
  SidePanel,
  Typography,
} from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Icon from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-icon';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', role: 'Agent', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', role: 'Supervisor', status: 'Inactive' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', role: 'Agent', status: 'Active' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(null);

  const columns = [
    { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
    { key: 'role', title: 'Role' },
    { key: 'status', title: 'Status' },
    {
      key: 'actions',
      title: 'Actions',
      render: (row) => (
        <Flex alignY="center" gap="2" data-qa={`row-${row.id}-actions`}>
          <Button
            aria-label={`Edit ${row.name}`}
            data-qa={`row-${row.id}-edit`}
            shape="compact"
            type="secondary"
            variation="transparent"
            tooltip={`Edit ${row.name}`}
            onClick={() => setEditing(row)}
          >
            <Icon name="edit" size="tiny" />
          </Button>
          <Button
            aria-label={`Delete ${row.name}`}
            data-qa={`row-${row.id}-delete`}
            shape="compact"
            type="danger"
            variation="transparent"
            tooltip={`Delete ${row.name}`}
            onClick={() => setDeleting(row)}
          >
            <Icon name="trash" size="tiny" />
          </Button>
        </Flex>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <BasicTable
        headers={columns}
        data={rows}
        currentPage={1}
        totalPages={1}
        onPageClick={() => {}}
      />

      <SidePanel
        visible={!!editing}
        onClose={() => setEditing(null)}
        title={editing ? `Edit ${editing.name}` : ''}
        size="small"
        actions={
          editing
            ? [
                {
                  label: 'Cancel',
                  type: 'secondary',
                  onClick: () => setEditing(null),
                },
                {
                  label: 'Save',
                  type: 'primary',
                  onClick: () => setEditing(null),
                },
              ]
            : []
        }
        data-qa="basictable-edit-side-panel"
      >
        {editing && (
          <Flex direction="column" gap="2">
            <Typography variant="body">
              Edit details for <strong>{editing.name}</strong>.
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption">Role: {editing.role}</Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption">Status: {editing.status}</Typography>
          </Flex>
        )}
      </SidePanel>

      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!deleting}
        onDismiss={() => setDeleting(null)}
        onAction={() => setDeleting(null)}
        iconName="trash"
        actionButtonType="danger"
        actionButtonText="Delete"
        data-qa="basictable-delete-confirm"
        content={
          deleting && (
            <>
              <Typography variant="body-emphasis">
                Delete {deleting.name}?
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="caption">
                This action cannot be undone.
              </Typography>
            </>
          )
        }
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sortable Columns

Set `sortable: true` on any column definition to enable ascending / descending / unsorted cycling. The `onSortClick` callback receives the full sort map keyed by column key with values from the `SortDirection` enum (`'asc'`, `'desc'`, `''`).

- `isMultiSorting={false}` (default) — clicking a new column resets all other column sorts.
- `isMultiSorting={true}` — multiple columns can be sorted simultaneously.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { BasicTable, SortDirection } from '@wfm/ui-components';

const columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name', sortable: true },
  { key: 'score', title: 'Score', sortable: true },
  { key: 'team', title: 'Team' },
];

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', score: 92, team: 'Alpha' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', score: 78, team: 'Beta' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', score: 85, team: 'Alpha' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Dave', score: 61, team: 'Beta' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  const [sort, setSort] = useState({});
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={columns}
      data={rows}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      defaultSort={sort}
      onSortClick={setSort}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Custom Cell Renderer

Use the `render` function on a column to display arbitrary React content instead of the raw field value. The function receives the full row object and the row index.

```tsx preview
import { BasicTable, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', score: 92 },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', score: 45 },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', score: 76 },
];

const columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
  {
    key: 'score',
    title: 'Score',
    render: (row) => (
      <Box padding={1}>
        <Typography
          variant="body-emphasis"
          color={
            row.score >= 75
              ? 'var(--co-color-green-600)'
              : 'var(--co-color-red-600)'
          }
        >
          {row.score}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    ),
  },
];

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={columns}
      data={rows}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Pagination

When `totalPages > 1` a paginator is rendered below the table. The `currentPage` prop controls the highlighted page; `onPageClick` is called with the new page number. `maxPagesCount` (default `9`) limits how many page buttons are visible at once. The table fills its parent height, keeps the body scrollable, and docks the paginator below the scrollable body.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { BasicTable } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

const allRows = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: String(i + 1),
  name: `Agent ${i + 1}`,
  team: i % 2 === 0 ? 'Alpha' : 'Beta',
}));

const PAGE_SIZE = 5;

export default function Demo() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(allRows.length / PAGE_SIZE);
  const data = allRows.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE);

  return (
    <Box height="400px">
      <BasicTable
        headers={[
          { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
          { key: 'team', title: 'Team' },
        ]}
        data={data}
        currentPage={page}
        totalPages={totalPages}
        onPageClick={setPage}
      />
    </Box>
  );
}
```

## Loading State

Set `isFetching={true}` to replace row content with animated skeleton placeholders. The number of skeleton rows matches the default row count (10).

```tsx preview
import { BasicTable } from '@wfm/ui-components';

const columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
  { key: 'role', title: 'Role' },
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={columns}
      data={[]}
      isFetching
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Error State

Set `isRequestError={true}` to show the error widget. Provide `onRefresh` to enable the Refresh button inside it.

```tsx preview
import { BasicTable } from '@wfm/ui-components';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={[
        { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
        { key: 'role', title: 'Role' },
        { key: 'team', title: 'Team' },
        { key: 'status', title: 'Status' },
        { key: 'shift', title: 'Shift' },
        { key: 'timezone', title: 'Timezone' },
      ]}
      data={[]}
      isRequestError
      onRefresh={() => alert('Refreshing…')}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Empty State — Default

When `data` is an empty array and neither `isFetching` nor `isRequestError` is set, the built-in `NoResultsWidget` is rendered automatically.

Pass `onAdd` to show a primary Add button below the widget. When `onAdd` is omitted the button is not rendered.

- Top: no `onAdd` — widget only, no button
- Bottom: `onAdd` provided with a custom `addLabel` — button appears below the widget

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { BasicTable } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

const headers = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
  { key: 'role', title: 'Role' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  const [added, setAdded] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Flex direction="column" gap="6">
      <BasicTable
        headers={headers}
        data={[]}
        currentPage={1}
        totalPages={1}
        onPageClick={() => {}}
      />
      <BasicTable
        headers={headers}
        data={[]}
        currentPage={1}
        totalPages={1}
        onPageClick={() => {}}
        onAdd={() => setAdded(true)}
        addLabel={added ? 'Added!' : 'Add Agent'}
      />
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Empty State — Custom

Pass `emptyStateComponent` to replace the default widget with any React content. Use this to show a context-specific message instead of the generic illustration.

```tsx preview
import { BasicTable, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={[
        { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
        { key: 'role', title: 'Role' },
      ]}
      data={[]}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
      emptyStateComponent={
        <Flex padding="6" alignX="center">
          <Typography variant="body">
            No agents match your current filter.
          </Typography>
        </Flex>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

## Column Widths

Set `width` on any column definition to control how much horizontal space it takes. The value maps directly to Cobalt's flex-basis classes: multiples of `5` from `5` to `100` (as percentages), plus `33`, `66`, and `'min'` (shrink to fit content). Columns without a `width` prop share the remaining space equally.

- `width={20}` — column takes 20% of the table width
- `width="min"` — column shrinks to the minimum width needed by its content

```tsx preview
import { BasicTable } from '@wfm/ui-components';

const columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name', width: 30 },
  { key: 'email', title: 'Email', width: 40 },
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status', width: 'min' },
];

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@example.com', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', email: 'bob@example.com', status: 'Inactive' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', email: 'carol@example.com', status: 'Active' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={columns}
      data={rows}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Expandable Rows

Pass `renderExpandedRow` to make each row expandable. The function receives the row data and its index, and should return the panel content rendered below the row when expanded. Clicking anywhere on a row toggles its expanded state. A leading chevron column is added automatically.

```tsx preview
import { useState } from 'react';
import { BasicTable, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';

const columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
  { key: 'role', title: 'Role' },
  { key: 'team', title: 'Team' },
];

const rows = [
  {
    id: '1',
    name: 'Alice',
    role: 'Agent',
    team: 'Alpha',
    email: 'alice@example.com',
    hired: 'Jan 2022',
  },
  {
    id: '2',
    name: 'Bob',
    role: 'Supervisor',
    team: 'Beta',
    email: 'bob@example.com',
    hired: 'Mar 2021',
  },
  {
    id: '3',
    name: 'Carol',
    role: 'Agent',
    team: 'Alpha',
    email: 'carol@example.com',
    hired: 'Sep 2023',
  },
];

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={columns}
      data={rows}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
      renderExpandedRow={(row) => (
        <Box padding={4} style={{ background: 'var(--basic-100, #f8f9fa)' }}>
          <Flex gap="6">
            <Flex direction="column" gap="1">
              <Typography variant="body-emphasis">Email</Typography>
              <Typography variant="body" weight="light">
                {row.email}
              </Typography>
            </Flex>
            <Flex direction="column" gap="1">
              <Typography variant="body-emphasis">Hired</Typography>
              <Typography variant="body" weight="light">
                {row.hired}
              </Typography>
            </Flex>
          </Flex>
        </Box>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

## Column Header Tooltips

Use the `tooltip` prop on any column definition to show an info icon next to the header label. Hovering the icon displays the tooltip text. The popup wraps long text and caps at **300 px wide**, so multi-line tooltips are fully supported.

```tsx preview
import { BasicTable } from '@wfm/ui-components';

const columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
  {
    key: 'aht',
    title: 'AHT',
    tooltip:
      'Average Handle Time — the mean duration of a single agent interaction including talk time and after-call work.',
  },
  {
    key: 'occupancy',
    title: 'Occupancy',
    tooltip:
      'The percentage of time an agent spends handling interactions versus available idle time.',
  },
];

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', aht: '3m 12s', occupancy: '82%' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', aht: '4m 05s', occupancy: '74%' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', aht: '2m 48s', occupancy: '91%' },
];

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={columns}
      data={rows}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Message Component

Use `messageComponent` to render arbitrary content as the first row inside the table body, above the data rows. This is designed for inline banners — such as import status messages, applied-filter notices, or warnings — that are contextually tied to the table content.

```tsx preview
import { BasicTable, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Icon from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-icon';

const columns = [
  { key: 'name', title: 'Name' },
  { key: 'role', title: 'Role' },
  { key: 'status', title: 'Status' },
];

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', role: 'Agent', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', role: 'Supervisor', status: 'Inactive' },
];

const ImportBanner = () => (
  <Flex
    alignY="center"
    gap="2"
    padding="2"
    style={{
      background: 'var(--color-background-info-subtle, #e8f4fd)',
      borderRadius: 4,
    }}
  >
    <Icon
      name="info_outline"
      size="tiny"
      style={{ color: 'var(--blue-600, #1a73e8)' }}
    />
    <Typography variant="body" weight="light">
      3 agents imported successfully. Showing updated list.
    </Typography>
  </Flex>
);

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={columns}
      data={rows}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
      messageComponent={<ImportBanner />}
    />
  );
}
```

## Internationalization (messages)

Use the `messages` prop to override all display strings — empty state labels, error widget labels, and pagination button text. Each key is optional; omitted keys fall back to English defaults.

```tsx preview
import { BasicTable } from '@wfm/ui-components';

const zhMessages = {
  noResultsTitle: '暂无数据',
  noResultsMessage: '请调整搜索条件后重试。',
  noResultsAlt: '暂无数据',
  badRequestTitle: '加载失败',
  badRequestMessage: '数据加载时出现错误，请刷新重试。',
  badRequestAlt: '错误',
  refresh: '刷新',
  paginationPrevious: '上一页',
  paginationNext: '下一页',
};

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <BasicTable
      headers={[{ key: 'name', title: '姓名' }]}
      data={[]}
      messages={zhMessages}
      currentPage={1}
      totalPages={1}
      onPageClick={() => {}}
    />
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop                  | Type                                            | Default           | Description                                                             |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `headers`             | `BasicTableColumn<T>[]`                         | —                 | Column definitions (key, title, sortable, render)                       |
| `data`                | `T[]`                                           | —                 | Row data; each item should have a unique `id`                           |
| `currentPage`         | `number`                                        | —                 | Active page (1-based)                                                   |
| `totalPages`          | `number`                                        | —                 | Total number of pages                                                   |
| `onPageClick`         | `(page: number) => void`                        | —                 | Called when a page button is clicked                                    |
| `isFetching`          | `boolean`                                       | `false`           | Shows animated skeleton rows                                            |
| `isRequestError`      | `boolean`                                       | `false`           | Shows the error widget                                                  |
| `defaultSort`         | `Record<string, SortDirection>`                 | `{}`              | Initial sort state                                                      |
| `onSortClick`         | `(sort: Record<string, SortDirection>) => void` | —                 | Called when sort changes                                                |
| `onRefresh`           | `() => void`                                    | —                 | Refresh callback shown in the error widget                              |
| `onAdd`               | `() => void`                                    | —                 | Shows an Add button in the default empty state; omit to hide the button |
| `addLabel`            | `string`                                        | `'Add'`           | Label for the Add button in the empty state                             |
| `emptyStateComponent` | `ReactNode`                                     | —                 | Overrides the default no-results widget                                 |
| `messageComponent`    | `ReactNode`                                     | —                 | Rendered as the first row above the data rows                           |
| `renderExpandedRow`   | `(row: T, index: number) => ReactNode`          | —                 | Makes each row expandable; returns panel content                        |
| `messages`            | `BasicTableMessages`                            | —                 | Override display strings (see table below)                              |
| `isMultiSorting`      | `boolean`                                       | `false`           | Allow sorting by multiple columns                                       |
| `maxPagesCount`       | `number`                                        | `9`               | Max visible page buttons in the paginator                               |
| `data-qa`             | `string`                                        | `'basic-table'`   | QA selector                                                             |
| `data-component`      | `string`                                        | `'WFMBasicTable'` | Component identifier                                                    |

## BasicTableColumn Props

| Prop       | Type                                   | Required | Description                                     |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `key`      | `keyof T`                              | ✓        | Maps to a field on the row data                 |
| `title`    | `ReactNode`                            | ✓        | Column header content                           |
| `sortable` | `boolean`                              | —        | Enables sort indicators on this column          |
| `tooltip`  | `string`                               | —        | Info-icon tooltip shown beside the header title |
| `width`    | `ColumnWidth`                          | —        | Column width (percentage or `'min'`)            |
| `render`   | `(row: T, index: number) => ReactNode` | —        | Custom cell renderer                            |

## BasicTableMessages

All keys are optional. Omitted keys fall back to English defaults.

| Key                  | Default                                   |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `noResultsTitle`     | `'No results found'`                      |
| `noResultsMessage`   | `'Try adjusting your search or filters.'` |
| `noResultsAlt`       | `'No results'`                            |
| `badRequestTitle`    | `'Something went wrong'`                  |
| `badRequestMessage`  | `'An error occurred while loading data.'` |
| `badRequestAlt`      | `'Error'`                                 |
| `refresh`            | `'Refresh'`                               |
| `paginationPrevious` | `'Previous'`                              |
| `paginationNext`     | `'Next'`                                  |

## SortDirection Enum

| Value                    | String   | Description     |
| ------------------------ | -------- | --------------- |
| `SortDirection.ASC`      | `'asc'`  | Ascending sort  |
| `SortDirection.DESC`     | `'desc'` | Descending sort |
| `SortDirection.UNSORTED` | `''`     | No sort applied |
